captures.name: simple_session
captures.command: opencode run --format json "Print exactly one short sentence."
captures.notes: Despite the synthetic-fixture assumption, --format json is actually JSONL. Events: step_start, text, tool_use (the model called bash to echo), step_finish (reason='tool-calls'), step_start, text, step_finish (reason='stop'). Tokens carried on step_finish.part.tokens with cache.read/write fields.

captures.name: error_session
captures.notes: OpenCode exits 0 even when the model is not found. The single stdout line is an 'error' event; stderr carries a JS stack trace (ProviderModelNotFoundError). Parser must rely on the 'error' event, not on exit code.
